timeline.event: Built as CB&Q 9245 under EMD order E699, serial 3641.
Prototype photographed at Eola, Illinois, carrying the “Way of the Zephyrs” slogan.
Prototype photographed at Eola without the slogan, documenting a later appearance.
Retired by Burlington Northern as locomotive 542.

narrative: CB&Q 9245 was built in August 1946 under EMD order E699, serial 3641. Photographs document it carrying the "Way of the Zephyrs" slogan in October 1964, matching the general appearance represented by the BLI model. A January 1966 photograph shows it without the slogan, so the documented appearance was time-specific. The locomotive later became Burlington Northern 542 and remained in service until May 1983.
